mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within two months signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to anticipated economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% within a quarter signals supply chain disruptions or reduced manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer spending and business investment increase.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) within a month signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or if the Rank IC for this interaction signal remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL below 2%) combined with a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a controlled tightening cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real rates remain supportive of equity valuations.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or if the Rank IC for this interaction signal remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates strong manufacturing output, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth prospects improve.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.
